items.headline: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 3847.04/MWh
items.detail: Day-ahead market average clearing price for 2026-05-06 was Rs 3847.04/MWh across 96 15-min blocks (range Rs 249.3-10000.0/MWh).

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).
